details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. Citation [3] establishes that 2023 exceeded both 1°C and 2°F relative to the 20th-century average, but it does not establish that 2023 was the first year to do so.
2. Citation [2] says 2023 was the first year in which every day exceeded 1°C above the pre-industrial level. That is a different claim and does not identify the first year in which the annual anomaly exceeded both specified thresholds.
3. Citation [6] lists 2015 as exceeding both thresholds relative to its stated pre-industrial baseline, but does not support 2023 as the first year, and uses a different reference baseline.
4. Therefore, the retrieved citations do not establish the gold answer’s key claim that 2023 was the first year since 1880 to meet both thresholds.
